detail: Formulas use state_lag1, refined_state_lag1, lagged QQQ activity, trailing stress/recovery counts, trailing state changes, and lagged dwell age.
Signal panel excludes future regime labels; current market_state/refined_state retained only for diagnostics and same-state baselines.
Signal panel does not include forward return, target, or future path columns.
Validation uses deterministic calendar subperiods and pre-2016/2016-forward holdout comparisons.
Only SSS high-priority/promising rules and watchlist NEEDS_TRIPLE_BARRIER_VALIDATION rules were converted.
Script reads production, shadow, and GGG1 artifacts only; it creates no strategy variants or portfolio candidates.
